text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Oh? I thought someone called my name...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Nobody's here. If there were anyone at 
all—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Could it be... the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. There's no way, right? 
Still, since we're here, maybe I should 
offer a little prayer.
